name: Full Body Reset
description: A calm, whole-body stretch break on your feet.

steps.title: March gently
steps.text: Stand tall and march slowly on the spot for about half a minute, swinging your arms.

steps.title: Reach up
steps.text: Raise your arms and stretch toward the ceiling, then lower them slowly.

steps.title: Side reaches
steps.text: Reach one arm overhead and lean gently to the side, then switch. Keep your movements easy.

steps.title: Soft forward bend
steps.text: With your knees a little bent, tip forward slightly from the hips only as far as feels comfortable, then slowly stand up.

steps.title: Shake it out
steps.text: Let your arms and legs shake out loosely, then take three slow breaths. Move slowly and only as far as feels comfortable. Stop if anything hurts.
